recap.text: Lucia Mar whispers to Crawler Carl that Chalchiuhtlicue is here and may let the children die to protect them. Azra tells Yaz that the shining lady says Carl won races with a spell from their father who owns a bowling alley. Samantha says Chachi once had worshippers kill a village day care because meatballs had cilantro in them. Rosetta says Chachi is a weak catch-all goddess of childbirth, women, water, fire, and harvests.

beats.headline: Here, says Lucia
beats.text: For the record: Crawler Carl's Scavenger's Daughter patch blinks, not knowing what it sees, and Lucia Mar crosses from her moped to him in a blink and whispers in his ear. Chalchiuhtlicue is here. She is new to this place, and she does not need Cici or Gus the way the Residual and the Primal did. She tells the children she is kind and means to protect them, and that the kindest thing may be to let them die. More are coming. The veins are open. All seek the prize on the twelfth floor. Then the presence is gone, and the patch shudders in fear.
beats.gist: Lucia Mar whispers to Carl that Chalchiuhtlicue is here and tells children she may let them die.

beats.headline: The shining lady talks to Yaz
beats.text: When the presence withdraws, a frightened child surfaces in Lucia's body instead: Azra, whose sister Yaz is here too, crying. The shining lady, Azra says, is talking to Yaz, telling her Crawler Carl won his races with a spell their father gave him. Their father owns a bowling alley. The angel lady, Azra says, thinks it might be better if they all die, and keeps talking about people coming to take their bodies. It is so cold. Florin asks who is coming. Azra notices him, shrieks, and runs.
beats.gist: Azra surfaces in Lucia's body and tells Florin a shining lady is talking to Yaz.

beats.headline: Samantha knows her
beats.text: Samantha, sniffing Crawler Carl, wants to know why he smells like Chachi. Chalchiuhtlicue, she clarifies: green skirt, talks funny, cries a lot. Her assessment: Chachi is pretty, not emotionally stable, and always talking about saving the lives of children before killing them all. Once, at a party, the meatballs had cilantro in them, so Chachi had her worshippers kill a whole village day care in the hope the next tray tasted better. It worked, Samantha adds. Carl realises this is the goddess Lucia named.
beats.gist: Samantha tells Carl that Chalchiuhtlicue wears a green skirt and kills day care children over cilantro.

beats.headline: Rarely sponsored, often weak
beats.text: Crawler Carl asks around. Rosetta: Chachi, as Samantha calls her, is not well known and has never been sponsored that she remembers. Like Eileithyia, she is a goddess of childbirth and women, but also of water and fire, and of harvests. Catch-all deities look good on the manifest and do poorly in the Ascendency game, their powers being comparatively weak. Crawler Donut declares that she is to be called Chachi. Prepotente supplies the Earth analog, an Aztec goddess of the same name, benevolent, whose crying for many days began a flood myth.
beats.gist: Carl asks Rosetta about Chalchiuhtlicue, a goddess of childbirth, women, water, fire, and harvests.
